memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: Designate a place outside the camp where you can go to relieve yourself. As part of your equipment have something to dig with, and when you relieve yourself, dig a hole and cover up your excrement. For the Lord your God moves about in your camp to protect you and to deliver your enemies to you. Your camp must be holy, so that he will not see among you anything indecent and turn away from you. - Deut 23:12-14 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
God gives instructions about basic sanitation in the camp, where to relieve oneself and how to keep the camp clean. On the surface this is simple hygiene, wise and healthful. But God gives a deeper reason, "For the Lord your God moves about in your camp." The presence of the holy God among them meant that even matters of cleanliness and order mattered.

There is something wonderful here. God was not distant or aloof. He was moving about in their very camp, present with them, protecting them, fighting for them. And because He was present, they were to keep the camp holy and orderly. His nearness shaped how they lived, even in the most practical, humble details of daily life.

This reveals a God who cares about the whole of our lives, not just the "spiritual" parts. He is not only present in our worship but in our homes, our work, our routines, our ordinary tasks. Because God dwells among His people, all of life becomes an arena for honouring Him. Under the new covenant, God's presence dwells in us by His Spirit, making our very bodies His temple (1 Cor 6:19). This lifts even the humblest tasks into something meaningful. Whatever we do, we can do it as those in whom God dwells. How does knowing God is present in every detail of your life change the way you approach the ordinary?

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Do you sense God's presence in the ordinary details of life?
2. How does God dwelling in you by His Spirit change your days?
3. What humble task can you do today as worship to Him?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, thank You that You are present in every part of my life. Help me honour You in the ordinary details, knowing You dwell within me. Amen.
